mapper.select: SELECT ac.concept_id, ac.file_id, ac.line_hint, ac.context_note, c.status, f.path AS file_path FROM analysis_concepts ac JOIN concepts c ON c.id = ac.concept_id LEFT JOIN analysis_files f ON f.id = ac.file_id WHERE ac.analysis_id = #{analysisId} ORDER BY ac.file_id IS NULL, ac.file_id, ac.concept_id

SELECT ac.concept_id, c.name, c.status, ac.context_note FROM analysis_concepts ac JOIN concepts c ON c.id = ac.concept_id WHERE ac.analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND c.status <> 'HIDDEN' ORDER BY ac.concept_id
